scope_words: Alert records are kept for 1 session: the session of 2026-11-03. This archive holds 75 alerts: the 25 largest alerts for each of SPY, QQQ and IWM for that session. The full prints were not retained, so this is the kept alerts only, not every alert that fired. The tape record names 7 recorded sessions in all; for the other recorded session it keeps how many prints were looked at, but no alert list. Earlier sessions and sessions that were not recorded are not in this archive.
source: Every options trade printed on the three big index funds during the trading day, scored print by print as it came in; this page keeps the largest alerts that record published
